subject: The truth about your first 14 days with SoulPlan
preview_text: I just checked your profile and discovered something most couples miss. It's a small mistake with big consequences.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks. That's the exact point where most couples using SoulPlan make a critical choice. They either look back and see a blank slate... or they realize they've quietly built something special without even noticing. Which one are you?

Here's the secret: you've accomplished more than you think. Every time you saved an idea, browsed a local spot, or even just opened the app thinking about your partner, you were building a map. A map of your relationship's potential. Most couples let those little moments of inspiration vanish into the ether. You didn't. You've been collecting them for 14 days straight. That's a treasure trove most people never get.

That map is your Date History. It's not just a log; it's your secret weapon against routine. It shows you what you love, what you dream about, and—most importantly—what you haven't tried yet. It turns 'I don't know' into 'Remember when we wanted to...?' It's the feature that turns casual browsing into a real plan.

Open SoulPlan right now and tap 'Date History'. Look at your collected ideas. See that map? That's two weeks of you choosing 'us.' Now, pick one from your wishlist and send it to your partner with a 'This weekend?' It takes 30 seconds. P.S. The couples who do this within their first month are 3x more likely to still be using the app (and having better dates) a year from now. Don't let your map gather dust.
